# JigsawDB v1.0.0-beta.13

This version pushes a focus on bug fixes for JigsawDB.

## Changelog

- Fixed bug where column configs were not able to be chained together.
- Added support for custom default values
- Fixed bug where the `in()` operation in WhereSelector required a non-empty array
- Added support for accounting encoding types to the resolution of the `FieldType`
